messages:
incident-bot: \u26a0\ufe0f High error rate detected: /v1/embeddings in eu-central-1. 5xx spike from 09:12:10 UTC. Potential routing/fallback anomaly. Paging sophie (oncall).

sophie (oncall): oncall here. seeing 5xx + "VariantNotSupported" traces. Pulling recent topology.

raj (eng-runtime): quick snapshot: alias 'prod-embed' pinned to v2.3, but resolver returned variant 'v2-chat' for many hosts in eu-central-1. That caused fallback path into chat-specialized runtime which rejects embedding requests -> 500.

marcus (infra): I rolled back the alias-sync cron for eu-central-1 at 09:14. Looks like a propagation from canary that overwrote the materialized view during a retry.

mike (sre): customer impact? SLA burn?

kira (support): customer-reported: NimbusAI batch jobs failing since 09:12. Ticket created NIM-442. They hit ~20% job failures.

alex (customer-success): reached out to NimbusAI lead, escalating. They want ETA and whether vectors were corrupted.

sophie (oncall): immediate mitigations: 1) pin traffic for prod-embed in eu-central-1 to known-good variant v1-embed-prod 2) disable auto-fallback to chat variants for embedding routes 3) start capture for mismatches to aid postmortem.

raj (eng-runtime): applying temporary route pin now. Patch:

```
# temp routing pin
route_pin:
  alias: prod-embed
  region: eu-central-1
  variant: v1-embed-prod
  disable_auto_fallback: true
```

Please ack to apply.

sophie (oncall): ack. apply and monitor.

deploy-bot: routing-pin-deploy-1967004321 started by raj. CI ok.

raj (eng-runtime): pin applied. Starting to see errors drop within 30s.

mike (sre): error rate down from 18% to 2.1% after pin. Good sign.

marcus (infra): found root: a backfill job from staging wrote an old mapping to the alias store due to a broken write-timeguard. The staging mapping carried a 'chat' tag. I've frozen backfill queue and will patch.

kira (support): NimbusAI confirms reduced failures. They will retry jobs. They asked for a brief incident note.

alex (customer-success): sending short note: "We routed your requests to a verified variant to restore service quickly. No vector data was modified; only routing change. We'll follow with a postmortem."

raj (eng-runtime): follow-ups: 1) add capability-check in resolver to reject variant choices that lack 'embedding' capability 2) add an invariant in alias-sync that prevents promotion of 'chat' tagged variants into embed aliases 3) add an alert for sudden variant-type churn on an alias. Implementing guard now as hotfix.

deploy-bot: runtime-guard-1967004321 build queued.

marcus (infra): patching alias-store write-timeguard to require environment tag match for writes coming from backfill. Deploying now.

raj (eng-runtime): hotfix deployed: resolver capability-check active in eu-central-1. For 10m we'll run in 'log-only' mode to ensure no false-positives, then enforce.

sophie (oncall): once logs look clean, we can unpin and re-enable guarded alias-sync. Keep auto-fallback disabled for embedding routes while we validate.

mike (sre): recommend a canary: re-enable alias-sync for 3 hosts then expand. Also create a dashboard for alias->variant capability mismatches.

raj (eng-runtime): logs for 12m show zero rejected compatible mappings. Ready to re-enable alias-sync at 5% rollout.

marcus (infra): alias-sync resumed at 5% with write-timeguard. No incompatible mappings observed.

raj (eng-runtime): safe to unpin in 20m if metrics stable. Will leave disable_auto_fallback true for embeddings.

sophie (oncall): unpin scheduled in 20m. Assign postmortem owners: raj + marcus + mike. Severity: Sev2 (customer batch failures, recoverable).

kira (support): NimbusAI confirmed final: their jobs passed on retry. They requested the postmortem and a short timeline.

alex (customer-success): sharing: "We contained impact within 30m by routing to a verified variant and disabling risky fallbacks. Postmortem to follow."

sophie (oncall): incident closed for oncall; postmortem doc path: /docs/incidents/1967004321-embed-prop-mismatch. Please add timeline entries.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: root-cause: staging backfill wrote stale mapping + missing resolver capability guard. Remediation: alias-store write guard, resolver capability check, alerting.
